description: This file defines the UserPreferencesController class within the Api\V8\Controller namespace. It handles HTTP requests related to user preferences, utilizing a UserPreferencesService to fetch preferences for a user. The class includes a constructor for dependency injection and a method getUserPreferences to process the request and response cycle, including error handling.
